@{68a9064d9b8a25d17e458d5b|full_name} Hi, there are multiple issues with this topic.

1. You're requesting to change existing functionality; that would be a feature request, not a bug report. You've submitted this to the bug reports category.

2. VRChat is unlikely to whitelist any virtual machines for security measures. Running VRChat in a virtual machine is documented, but not supported, and it may break at any moment. The request to allow virtual machines should be between ShadowPC and Epic Games, so this request may be misdirected at VRChat on this Canny.

3. This topic is a duplicate of the following feature requests, and can be merged with those:

- https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/whitelist-shadow-pc-please

- https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/allow-shadowpc-players-to-play-vrchat

pinnedComment.value:
After further investigation, we have determined that these issues with Shadow PC are outside of our control, and are not a result of any configurations we have changed. We cannot make changes to VRChat or its configuration that would fix these issues, or future issues with Shadow related to this particular problem.

We understand completely that continued issues with Shadow may come as a disappointment, and that some users utilize Shadow to access VRChat. We feel it too - some of our team members are affected by these problems as well.

While VRChat may work under VMs such as Shadow PC, we cannot guarantee support for any specific VM setup. There are many factors at play and nearly all of them are outside of our ability to affect or control. As we note in [our documentation](https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/using-vrchat-in-a-virtual-machine), using VRChat via a Virtual Machine is not directly supported, but is possible to do if you are an interested player with the appropriate technical expertise. 

In other words: "it might work, but we can't guarantee it'll keep working, and we won't help you if it breaks." That might sound harsh, but we simply don't have the ability to support these types of setups.

In this particular case, the most we can do is encourage those affected to contact Shadow's support for more information.
